LanguageData.LP_DK_Sway.label: drunken sway
LanguageData.LP_DK_Sway.description: Passive: move speed +0.2, melee dodge +10. Drunken Master, monk level 3.
LanguageData.LP_DK_Redirect.label: redirect attack
LanguageData.LP_DK_Redirect.description: Passive: when an enemy hits you in melee, a 25% success chance to turn the blow aside (no damage) and stun the attacker for 1 second. At most once every 3 seconds. Drunken Master, monk level 6.
LanguageData.LP_DK_Numb.label: drunken numbness
LanguageData.LP_DK_Numb.description: Passive: pain shock threshold +15%, mind resistance +20%. Drunken Master, monk level 11.
LanguageData.LP_DK_Frenzy.label: intoxicated frenzy
LanguageData.LP_DK_Frenzy.description: Strike each adjacent enemy (up to 5) with two full melee attacks. Ki 3, cooldown 20 seconds. Drunken Master, monk level 17.
LanguageData.LP_KS_Path.label: path of the kensei
LanguageData.LP_KS_Path.description: Passive: with a melee weapon in hand, melee hit chance +10%, melee dodge +5. Kensei, monk level 3.
LanguageData.LP_KS_OneWithBlade.label: one with the blade
LanguageData.LP_KS_OneWithBlade.description: Passive: melee weapon hits deal ×1.1 damage with +20% armor penetration. Kensei, monk level 6.
LanguageData.LP_KS_Sharpen.label: sharpen the blade
LanguageData.LP_KS_Sharpen.description: For 60 seconds melee damage ×1.25. Ki 2, cooldown 2 minutes. Kensei, monk level 11.
LanguageData.LP_KS_Unerring.label: unerring accuracy
LanguageData.LP_KS_Unerring.description: Passive: melee weapon hits have a 15% success chance to deal double damage. Kensei, monk level 17.
LanguageData.LP_ZL_DivineFury.label: divine fury
LanguageData.LP_ZL_DivineFury.description: Passive: melee damage ×1.15 while raging. Zealot, barbarian level 3.
LanguageData.LP_ZL_Focus.label: fanatical focus
LanguageData.LP_ZL_Focus.description: Passive: mind resistance +20%, pain shock threshold +10%. Zealot, barbarian level 7.
LanguageData.LP_ZL_Presence.label: zealous presence
LanguageData.LP_ZL_Presence.description: A war cry: you and allies within 8 cells get melee hit chance +10% and move speed ×1.1 for 30 seconds. Cooldown 2 hours. Zealot, barbarian level 11.
LanguageData.LP_ZL_BeyondDeath.label: rage beyond death
LanguageData.LP_ZL_BeyondDeath.description: Passive: damage taken ×0.85 while raging. Zealot, barbarian level 15.
LanguageData.LP_AG_Protectors.label: ancestral protectors
LanguageData.LP_AG_Protectors.description: Passive: enemies you hit in melee while raging are hounded by ancestral spirits for 6 seconds: their damage against anyone but you is ×0.75. Ancestral Guardian, barbarian level 3.
LanguageData.LP_AG_SpiritShield.label: spirit shield
LanguageData.LP_AG_SpiritShield.description: Passive: while you rage, allies within 6 cells take ×0.85 damage. Ancestral Guardian, barbarian level 7.
LanguageData.LP_AG_Consult.label: consult the spirits
LanguageData.LP_AG_Consult.description: Passive: learning speed ×1.15, mind resistance +15%. Ancestral Guardian, barbarian level 11.
LanguageData.LP_AG_Vengeful.label: vengeful ancestors
LanguageData.LP_AG_Vengeful.description: Passive: whatever damage spirit shield blocks, the attacker takes as force damage. Ancestral Guardian, barbarian level 15.
LanguageData.LP_WN_Dreadful.label: dreadful strikes
LanguageData.LP_WN_Dreadful.description: Passive: weapon hits on enemies deal ×1.1 damage. Fey Wanderer, ranger level 3.
LanguageData.LP_WN_Beguiling.label: beguiling presence
LanguageData.LP_WN_Beguiling.description: Passive: mind resistance +20%, social impact +15%, negotiation ability +15%. Fey Wanderer, ranger level 7.
LanguageData.LP_WN_Glamour.label: beguiling mist
LanguageData.LP_WN_Glamour.description: Enemies within 4 cells are shaken for 10 seconds; those who fail to resist (mind resistance) are also stunned for 2 seconds. Cooldown 1 minute. Fey Wanderer, ranger level 11.
LanguageData.LP_WN_MistyStep.label: misty wanderer
LanguageData.LP_WN_MistyStep.description: Step through the mist to a visible empty cell within 12 cells. Cooldown 20 seconds. Fey Wanderer, ranger level 15.
LanguageData.LP_HW_PlanarWarrior.label: planar warrior
LanguageData.LP_HW_PlanarWarrior.description: Passive: weapon hits on enemies add 8 × hunt power force damage, once every 5 seconds. Horizon Walker, ranger level 3.
LanguageData.LP_HW_EtherealStep.label: ethereal step
LanguageData.LP_HW_EtherealStep.description: For 10 seconds damage taken ×0.5 and move speed ×1.2. Cooldown 2 minutes. Horizon Walker, ranger level 7.
LanguageData.LP_HW_DistantStrike.label: distant strike
LanguageData.LP_HW_DistantStrike.description: Teleport to a visible empty cell within 10 cells; for the next 5 seconds weapon damage ×1.2. Cooldown 8 seconds. Horizon Walker, ranger level 11.
LanguageData.LP_HW_Spectral.label: spectral defense
LanguageData.LP_HW_Spectral.description: Passive: the first damage you take every 5 seconds is halved. Horizon Walker, ranger level 15.
LanguageData.LP_WF_Seed.label: fiery seed
LanguageData.LP_WF_Seed.description: An enemy within 20 cells takes 12 × verdant power flame damage and is set on fire. Mana 1, cooldown 5 seconds. Circle of Wildfire, druid level 2.
LanguageData.LP_WF_Bond.label: wildfire spirit
LanguageData.LP_WF_Bond.description: Passive: druid spells and abilities are ×1.1 as effective. Circle of Wildfire, druid level 6.
LanguageData.LP_WF_Cauterize.label: cauterizing flames
LanguageData.LP_WF_Cauterize.description: Passive: when an enemy dies within 10 cells of you, you and the most wounded ally within 10 cells each heal 6 + druid level. At most once every 10 seconds. Circle of Wildfire, druid level 10.
LanguageData.LP_WF_Rebirth.label: blazing revival
LanguageData.LP_WF_Rebirth.description: Passive: when about to go down, rise in flame: heal half your wounds and stop bleeding. Once per day. Circle of Wildfire, druid level 14.
LanguageData.LP_GL_Mantle.label: mantle of inspiration
LanguageData.LP_GL_Mantle.description: You and allies within 8 cells each gain an absorb shield of (6 + bard level) × bardic power for 30 seconds. Costs 1 melody, cooldown 1 minute. College of Glamour, bard level 3.
LanguageData.LP_GL_Enthrall.label: enthralling performance
LanguageData.LP_GL_Enthrall.description: Passive: social impact +20%, negotiation ability +20%, trade price improvement +5%. College of Glamour, bard level 7.
LanguageData.LP_GL_Majesty.label: mantle of majesty
LanguageData.LP_GL_Majesty.description: Command an enemy within 15 cells to kneel: if it fails to resist (mind resistance) it is stunned for 4 seconds; even if it resists it is shaken for 10 seconds. Costs 1 melody, cooldown 20 seconds. College of Glamour, bard level 11.
LanguageData.LP_GL_Unbreakable.label: unbreakable majesty
LanguageData.LP_GL_Unbreakable.description: For 60 seconds damage taken ×0.7 and mind resistance +30%. Costs 2 melody, cooldown 1 day. College of Glamour, bard level 15.
LanguageData.LP_BH_Mark.label: bounty mark
LanguageData.LP_BH_Mark.description: Mark an enemy within 30 cells for 60 seconds: your damage to it is ×1.2. Costs 1 grit, cooldown 30 seconds. Bounty Hunter, gunslinger level 3.
LanguageData.LP_BH_Tracker.label: expert tracker
LanguageData.LP_BH_Tracker.description: Passive: move speed +0.2, shooting accuracy +1. Bounty Hunter, gunslinger level 3.
LanguageData.LP_BH_Bola.label: hobbling shot
LanguageData.LP_BH_Bola.description: Tangle the legs of an enemy within 20 cells: move speed ×0.5 for 8 seconds. Costs 1 grit, cooldown 20 seconds. Bounty Hunter, gunslinger level 7.
LanguageData.LP_BH_Payday.label: payday
LanguageData.LP_BH_Payday.description: Passive: when an enemy you marked dies, you regain 1 grit and heal 10. Bounty Hunter, gunslinger level 11.
LanguageData.LP_BH_DeadOrAlive.label: dead or alive
LanguageData.LP_BH_DeadOrAlive.description: Passive: bounty mark damage multiplier ×1.2 → ×1.4, and the mark lasts 120 seconds. Bounty Hunter, gunslinger level 15.
LanguageData.LP_SR_Foresight.label: foresight
LanguageData.LP_SR_Foresight.description: Passive: melee dodge +8, shooting accuracy +1. Seer, psion level 3.
LanguageData.LP_SR_Premonition.label: premonition
LanguageData.LP_SR_Premonition.description: Warn an ally within 20 cells (or yourself): for 30 seconds damage taken ×0.8 and melee dodge +10. Costs 1 psi point, cooldown 10 seconds. Seer, psion level 3.
LanguageData.LP_SR_Expose.label: expose weakness
LanguageData.LP_SR_Expose.description: See through an enemy within 24 cells: for 20 seconds it takes ×1.15 damage. Costs 1 psi point, cooldown 15 seconds. Seer, psion level 6.
LanguageData.LP_SR_ThirdEye.label: third eye
LanguageData.LP_SR_ThirdEye.description: Passive: mind resistance +20%, psychic sensitivity +15%. Seer, psion level 6.
LanguageData.LP_SR_Precog.label: precognition
LanguageData.LP_SR_Precog.description: Passive: fully avoid one enemy attack every 10 seconds. Seer, psion level 10.
LanguageData.LP_SR_Rewind.label: rewrite fate
LanguageData.LP_SR_Rewind.description: Turn time back: you and allies within 8 cells each heal 15 × psionic power and are freed from stun. Costs 4 psi points, cooldown 1 day. Seer, psion level 14.
